name: Vág (Hungary)
description: A red hoist panel bearing the municipal arms of Vág (a red shield with a church, a bridge and a fish), and at the fly two horizontal stripes of green over blue separated from each other and from the hoist by white lines.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: red hoist panel with white separator
